entendimento: The ISA changes from RV32I to RV32IM. The existing RV32I datapath, interfaces, and behavior remain valid; the CPU must additionally recognize opcode 0x33 with funct7 0x01 and write the correct MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU, DIV, DIVU, REM, or REMU result in the same single-cycle instruction. Division by zero and signed division overflow must follow the specified RISC-V results. The smallest change is to update the decoder to enable register writes for valid M encodings, then have the CPU select a combinational M result for writeback. The ALU and other existing blocks can remain unchanged.

mudancas.decoder: Recognize opcode 0x33 with funct7 0x01 and any funct3 from 000 through 111 as valid register-writing instructions. Use the existing OP register-write and operand-source controls, with a neutral ALU selector such as ADD because the CPU will bypass the ALU result for M instructions. Preserve the existing RV32I decoding and unsupported-encoding behavior.
mudancas.cpu: Keep the fixed public ports and existing instances. Add combinational M-operation detection and result generation for opcode 0x33/funct7 0x01, selecting the operation by funct3. Use the M result instead of the ALU result for writeback on these instructions, while retaining the decoder's register-write enable and the register file's x0 behavior. Compute full-width products for the high-half variants, including signed-by-unsigned MULHSU; implement signed and unsigned division/remainder with explicit divide-by-zero handling and signed overflow handling before division. Keep execution single-cycle.
